Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. As we narrow vendors for our payments platform, our security and ops teams have asked for an "operational readiness packet" focused on Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery so we can validate your RTO/RPO claims against our procurement criteria. Can you provide the following: 

- A short BCP/DR executive summary (top-level failover flows, responsible teams)
- RTO and RPO targets by service tier (control plane, API/ingestion, embeddings, model serving state)
- The most recent full DR test report (date, scope, results, observed recovery times)
- Runbooks or playbook excerpts for failover and rollback steps (redacted credentials ok)
- Any third-party dependencies that materially affect RTO/RPO (cloud provider, KMS/HSM, DB vendor)
- A signed attestation or contact for SOC/SIG reviewer to confirm accuracy

We need this evidence by EOD Monday (2026-08-24) if possible — SignalPay has an internal review next week. If some items are sensitive, a redacted packet with a secure link or DocuSign attestation would also work.

Elena — thanks for the clear list. We're assembling a concise packet and I attached the initial artifacts below. High-level notes up front:

- Executive summary attached (BCP-Summary-2026.pdf) — one page with our failover model and escalation matrix.
- RTO/RPO matrix attached (RTO-RPO-Matrix-202606.csv) — shows targets by service tier and observed medians from the last three tests.
- Full DR test run (DR-Test-Run-20260715.pdf) — last full run was 2026-07-15, included a primary->secondary region failover, and contains timestamps for component-level recovery.

Preliminary RTO/RPO highlights (see matrix for details):
- Control plane failover (leader election + API routing): RTO target 5 minutes, observed median 4m 12s in last test.
- Stateless inference nodes (auto-replace + warm caches): RTO target 3 minutes for warm path; on cold starts median 11m.
- Embeddings pipeline (materialized stores + batched re-ingest): RTO target 30 minutes; RPO target 15 minutes for the incremental store.
- Persistent metadata (customer configs, keys): RPO near-zero via synchronous commit across control-plane replicas (sub-second for config writes).

Attachments included: BCP-Summary-2026.pdf (PDF), DR-Test-Run-20260715.pdf (PDF), RTO-RPO-Matrix-202606.csv (CSV). I'm copying Marissa (CS lead) and Karthik (Solutions) in case you want a call to walk the packet.

If you need additional attestation, I can circulate a signed BCP attestation and a DocuSign for your records — I expect to have that by Monday.

Thanks,

Rafael — thanks for the quick turnaround and the artifacts. A couple of clarifying items from our infra team after a quick pass: 

1) For the embeddings pipeline you list RPO 15 minutes — can you confirm whether checkpoints are full snapshots or incremental replication? We need to understand delta window and recovery steps if a partial restore is required.
2) Did the 2026-07-15 DR run include an inter-region failover (us-west -> us-east) with KMS/HSM key reattachment? Our compliance folks need to see whether key access was part of the test and how long re-keying added to the timeline.

Elena — thanks, answering each point below and attaching the attestation.

1) Embeddings pipeline replication: incremental checkpoints with 5-minute flush intervals. During normal operation we persist deltas to the incremental store; full snapshot cadence is daily (kept for 30 days). Recovery for the incremental store uses the last full snapshot + deltas; effective RPO measured during tests was 12 minutes (median). See RTO-RPO-Matrix-202606.csv (column: replication_pattern).

2) 2026-07-15 DR run details: yes, that run performed an inter-region failover (us-west-2 -> us-east-1). KMS key reattachment was exercised — we used cross-region key replicas and an automated rebind script; the added time observed for key reattachment was ~1m 40s. Evidence and the script excerpt are in DR-Test-Run-20260715.pdf.

3) Persistent metadata store: we use managed CockroachDB (self-hosted clusters on customer VPCs for Private customers; hosted customers run on managed CockroachDB 22.2). Replication lag charts from the test are included in the DR report appendix (page 6).

Attached: BCP-Attestation-2026.docx (signed), plus the artifacts previously sent. If SignalPay needs DocuSign, here is the link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abcd-2026-bcp-attestation — we can complete that today.

Next steps: Marissa is available to run a short 30-minute walkthrough of the packet with your infra/compliance teams; Karh tik can join to discuss any architecture-specific questions. Would Thu 2026-08-27 10:00 PT work for a call?

Best regards,
